title: Declamatory

inlines.v: DECLAM'ATORY, adjective 1. Relating to the practice of declaiming; pertaining to declamation; treated in the manner of a rhetorician; as a declamatory theme. 2. Appealing to the passions; noisy; rhetorical without solid sense or argument; as a declamatory way or style.
